notes.title: Back from the grave!
notes.content:
With Halloween getting closer, it's high time to make a comeback with a few new tricks up my sleeve!

I've been torturing my fellow demonic developers, and forced them into making some improvements to my fantastic adventure:

	- New point of view and camera fix, no more motion sickness for weak and fragile gamers.
	- New save system
	- Once you finish the game, a new unlock mode will be available, to play again and again till you drop dead like me.
	- Colliders have been improved, no more excuse for not playing.
	- Graphic config can be switched directly frow the game pad
	- Graphics have been improved, say farewell to that 2016 feel

That's all, and that's enough. Play already!

Slimy kisses from the other side,


Lord Darydikilkil

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Like Lord Darydikilkil, we came back from the dead with a small update. 
7 epic success have been added, and we improved the camera angle, for a more comfortable 3rd person mode.

A few minor bugs have also been corrected.

Have fun (and a merry Xmas)!
